answer: Locks are written down in sonnet, expire in nectar, and ripple lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 176 aliases as a result needs 40 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. That bill is paid per identity, so 364 aliases cost 165 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
